featured_reviews.name: RYAN SHAIKH
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited Mumbai Collection and was impressed with the variety of items available in the store. They have a great selection of stationary items, sports accessories, fashion items, cosmetics, and gift items. As a male, I was pleased to see that they had a wide range of items that catered to my needs as well. I was able to find some unique and trendy items, such as sports gear, backpacks, and grooming products. The staff were friendly and helpful, and they were able to help me find exactly what I was looking for. The prices were reasonable, and I felt that the quality of the items was good for the price. Overall, I highly recommend Mumbai Collection to any male looking for a one-stop-shop for a wide variety of items including stationary, sports, fashion accessories, cosmetics, and gifts.

featured_reviews.review_text:
This is the 2nd time I am posting a negative review. It looks like Messy Corner's removing bad reviews and get fake positive reviews

I posted a 1-star review yesterday (Nov 11th, 2025) and it seems to have been removed.

I had placed an order with them for multiple items. Two of the items were missing.

Repeated WhatsApp messages and calls are all unanswered. Their contact number is only used to confirm your order, and not to respond to any queries or complaints. The same goes for their email.

There do seem to be a lot of complaints, and with my review already being removed, one can only imagine all the removed complaints and fake positive reviews posted here.

Someone please have my missing items delivered.

Order ID - TMC391493

Items Missing - Personalized Pen, Cardholder

Items Received - Personalized Diary with normal blue pen, Keychain with picture, Extra diary sheets x2.

And is this your actual location and office?

Totally unprofessional and rude customer care! Please stay away from this company!
